config.sublang.title: SubLang Settings
config.sublang.sourceLanguage.tooltip: Language code to show as secondary name (e.g., en_us, ja_jp)
config.sublang.format.tooltip: Format string: %s = current name, %s = source name
config.sublang.showForSame.tooltip: Show source name even when it matches current name
config.sublang.excludedMods.tooltip: List of mod IDs to exclude from bilingual display
config.sublang.excludedItems.tooltip: List of item IDs to exclude (e.g., minecraft:diamond)
